name: topmind-desktop
description: topmind local-first desktop workspace for AI-assisted project work.
author: TopMindSpace

scripts.pack:dir: npm run build && npm run pack:prepare && node scripts/electron-builder-ci.mjs dir host && npm run pack:verify
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && npm run pack:prepare && node scripts/electron-builder-ci.mjs mac host && npm run pack:verify
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && npm run pack:prepare && node scripts/electron-builder-ci.mjs linux host && npm run pack:verify
scripts.pack:linux:arm64: npm run build && npm run pack:prepare && node scripts/electron-builder-ci.mjs linux arm64 && npm run pack:verify
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && npm run pack:prepare && node scripts/electron-builder-ci.mjs win host && npm run pack:verify
scripts.pack:mac:ci: npm run build && npm run pack:prepare && node scripts/electron-builder-ci.mjs mac host && npm run pack:verify:strict
scripts.pack:linux:ci: npm run build && npm run pack:prepare && node scripts/electron-builder-ci.mjs linux host && npm run pack:verify:strict
scripts.pack:win:ci: npm run build && npm run pack:prepare && node scripts/electron-builder-ci.mjs win host && npm run pack:verify:strict
scripts.validate: npm run deps:packaging && npm run typecheck && npm run check:electron && npm run check:dead-code && npm run check:i18n && npm run test && npm run build && npm run build:report && npm run pack:verify
